findings.claim: The sentence left CORS unstated: a direct VITE_API_URL to another localhost port is cross-origin and the candidate cannot apply the taught server-side fix to a provided npm-run API; it also inverted direction ('reaches the app through' the setting).
findings.recommendation: State that the provided API already permits the dev server's origin and that the app reads the address from the setting.

items.note: The blueprint carries a dedicated sentence making CORS explicit ('with the API already permitting the dev server's origin so no sitting depends on server-side CORS work') and corrects direction (the app reads the setting); feasible, value-free and within taught content.
